$comment: Copy this file to `.pi/settings.json` in a project repo and commit it. Teammates run `pi`, approve the trust prompt once, and Pi auto-installs the standard package on startup. This tracks the `main` branch: no auth token needed (public repo, anonymous clone) and no detached-HEAD notice (Pi stays on the branch). Tradeoff: you get whatever is on main at install/update time, not a frozen version — merges to main are gated by PR review.
